title: #190 - We Each Have Our Own Opinions
content:
#190 - We Each Have Our Own Opinions

Half a league east of Casterly Rock City, there is the coalition military camp.

The camp where the 12,000-strong army is stationed is already quite large. The entire military camp is roughly divided into two large parts according to the river and the river bend. There are relatively obvious boundaries between each family.

Because the composition of the soldiers was complex, the king organized a unified patrol, mainly composed of cavalry from Frey and Tyrell, to prevent conflicts between soldiers from each family.

At the gate, a dozen cavalrymen rushed into the camp. After entering the temporary stable area, auxiliary soldiers came to lead the horses.

The leader, Sir Bennard Brun, dismounted and lifted Tyrion off the horse.

This team had previously gone outside Casterly Rock to observe the terrain, and at the same time, the little devil pointed out the approximate location of the sewer from a distance.

Of course, Tyrion was restrained during the whole process, and Bennard did not dare to let the walking fifty thousand gold dragon escape from his hands.

"What's going on? Am I dazzled? There are four dragons flying in the sky."

After his hands were unbound, the little devil immediately rubbed his eyes and asked himself.

After his reminder, Bennard also looked up at the sky, "You are not dazzled, there are indeed four dragons. Although I don't understand why there are three more dragons."

Tyrion looked up for a while and then said: "A black dragon, a green dragon, and a golden and white two-color dragon. The largest one is the same size as Alduin, and the smaller two have a wingspan of almost five rice."

Bennard was also attracted by the dragon. After hearing what the dwarf said, he asked: "Why is this black dragon so smooth? Where are its spines?"

The two of them talked as they walked towards the king's tent.

"Actually, among the more than 20 dragons in the early Targaryen period, there is no dragon with as many thorns as Alduin. Black dragons are the norm. If the new black dragon can live to be more than a hundred years old, it can compete with As huge as Balerion, the Black Death, his dragon flames can melt glass, and no crossbow can penetrate the dragon's scales."

The Imp explains historical dragons to Bernard Brun.

Sir Brun nodded, "Although you are not as tall as me, your brain is much smarter. I can't distinguish between so many dragons."

While listening to the compliment, the little devil was thinking about what the arrival of these three dragons meant.

The two of them walked through the tent areas and were watched by many soldiers and nobles as they left.

If both men were not well known to the king, Lannister would have killed himself with a few swords in his back one night.

After entering the tent, Tyrion saw the person he expected.

A beautiful girl with silver hair and purple eyes.

In the king's tent, most of the distinguished nobles gathered together. Queen Margaery was holding her maid and crying, while Daenerys loudly spoke of her own ideas.

"Dragon Holder, in the records of the city, you are a Bracken, not a Targaryen. Even if you are really the illegitimate son of my brother Rhaegar, you will have to wait until I legalize you before you can be called a Targaryen. Leanne.”

Since many of the nobles in the account were members of the Dragon Party families, and most of the families supported the royal family when the usurper was here, Daenerys became bolder and began to discuss the succession issue with her so-called nephew.

The crowned king did not think so, "I am the king, and I have the right to change my surname to Targaryen."

The king's legalization of illegitimate children is one of the most basic rights, not to mention that Arthur's previous identity was not an illegitimate child, but a minor nobleman with clear pedigree and unmistakable identity.

Dany raised her eyebrows and smiled, her beautiful eyes showing a hint of doubt:

"Really? Let's sort out the truth in detail. Before you become the king, you cannot change your identity to a Targaryen, and you ascended the Iron Throne in the name of the Targaryen family. How can you be king without a Targaryen name?"

If Arthur was a noble leader before ascending the Iron Throne, there is indeed something wrong with his process.

At least becoming a king is in conflict with legitimizing oneself, and there is no solution.

"But let me remind you, I am the King of the Rivers first, the king supported by all the families in the entire Riverlands."

Arthur told a small lie, and until now, Riverrun has not recognized him as king.

"Then I changed my surname to Targaryen in the name of King of the River, and then I ascended the Iron Throne and became the King of the Seven Kingdoms and the Protector of the Realm."

The Dragon Queen was stunned. She thought about it for a long time before she understood the reason.

Dany was confused and asked the nobles behind her, "Does this process comply with the customs of Westeros and the laws of the Seven Kingdoms?"

Earl Clermont Piper, who took the lead in supporting Arthur I, immediately replied:

"No problem, Miss Dany. As the King of the River, His Majesty can indeed order to change his surname back, and then ascend the throne in the name of the Dragon Family."

Title is a very important issue. In view of the king's unclear attitude towards Stormborn who has three dragons, Clemont also calls her "Miss".

The other nobles nodded in agreement, and Marquis Aenys even shouted loudly, "Your Majesty was brought into King's Landing by several of our families, and there is no problem with his inheritance."

Dany looked at the bald man with disgust and remembered the twin towers emblem on Inis.

After wandering back and forth in front of the nobles and the king for a few times, the Dragon Queen said loudly:

"As a dragon family, whoever has more dragons is the king. I have three dragons, do you have one?"

Arthur, who was sitting in the main seat, looked back at his wife who was still crying. He did not respond to the question, but stood up and went to Margery's side.

"Don't be too sad, he just left after fulfilling his wish."

The king gently patted his wife on the shoulder and whispered a few words of comfort.

Daenerys has brought the news of the assassinations of Grand Maester Germain and Duke of Metz, making Margaery cry after losing her loved ones.

A hint of jealousy flashed in Daenerys's purple eyes. Apart from being a little thinner, this eldest nephew had simply grown to meet her aesthetic standards.

He is tall, with fair skin, deep eyes, straight nose, and handsome features.

What's more important are the charming black eyes.

She loved men with dark eyes.

As a symbolic queen, Margaery naturally wanted to give the king face. After listening to her husband's words, she barely stopped sobbing, looked at Arthur with her beautiful red eyes, and then gently hugged her husband. .

"Honey, I'm glad you're here."

Margaery pretended to have a deep relationship with the king.

But in fact, the two just have a close friendship.

The true heart-felt feelings need to be cultivated slowly and deeply.

Looking at the beauty with pear blossoms and rain in front of him, the king suddenly felt a desire to conquer and wanted to get on his horse and fight on the spot, but business was more important.

The "love" scene between the two made Daenerys jealous for no reason.

Her red little mouth turned up.

After Margaery's mood stabilized, the king returned to the main seat and answered the Dragon Queen's proposal.

"But you can only ride one dragon at a time."

He looked around the circle of nobles, and then found support for himself in the eyes of this group of people.

Arthur was greatly emboldened and said loudly: "Let's do this. When the West, the Stormlands, and the North are calmed down, we will follow Jaehaerys I and convene the Great Council of Lords at Harrenhal, and let all the House Governors vote and elect A true king. Do you think that’s possible?”

In the 101st year of the Conquest Calendar, a grand gathering of lords was held at Harrenhal. This should be the first time in the history of Westeros that all the lords appeared in one place at the same time.

After getting tired of standing, Danni sat down on the chair prepared for her, put her arms on the armrests, and said domineeringly:

"Put away your little thoughts, don't think that I don't know what your intentions are. No matter how mediocre the male heir is, the lords will only choose men to be kings."

Having been Khaleesi for almost two years and queen for more than a year, Daenerys already has a powerful aura about her.

This kind of aura can even affect people around him, such as Marquis Frey. After the Dragon Queen sat down, he stood much straighter.

But Arthur also has the aura of a superior person, and it is more violent and bloody.

To be precise, Arthur I's aura is more powerful than Dany's.

"You want to sit on the Iron Throne, and I have already sat on the Iron Throne, so there is a conflict. Do you want to recreate the civil war during the Dance of the Blood Dragons two hundred years ago?"

Arthur asked sharply.

"I..." Daenerys was about to retort, but was quickly interrupted by the king.

"We Targaryens are already depleted in population, and you are still so ignorant. Do you want me to teach you how to do it?"

Arthur said without blushing that he was a Targaryen.

Dany glanced at her domineering nephew and suddenly felt the desire to conquer.

She raised her eyebrows and smiled slightly, "Then you should teach me. I just want to see how the wise Arthur handles this dilemma."

Daenerys emphasized the word "wise" in an attempt to mock the king in this way.

"Your Majesty, I have a suggestion."

Tyrion, who was half a man tall, struggled to squeeze to the front and suggested loudly, "How about you get married and share the title of king."

Although the Dragon Queen and the King looked like they were about to fall out on the spot, the keen little devil had already noticed that the two of them admired each other, and the smiles in their four eyes almost overflowed.

Based on Tyrion's experience of visiting the House of Commons, he thought that if there was no one else in the tent, the two of them could hug and kiss on the spot.

"Marry?" Prince Oberyn, who was sitting aside and chatting quietly with his mistress, suddenly said, "I have a suggestion. Why don't Prince Dany marry my brother's eldest son. He should be going to Slaver's Bay to find you now. "

Dany glared at the melancholy middle-aged man fiercely. It took her a while before she noticed the crest with the golden spear piercing the sun, and guessed that this man was a prince of the Dorne Martell family.

"The men who want to marry me can be queued from Slaver's Bay to King's Landing, and then to Casterly Rock in the West, but it's the turn of an unknown boy from Dorne?"

The Dragon Queen declined the marriage proposal.

Dorne would not be of great help to her in inheriting the Iron Throne, and she did not want to constrain herself with such a marriage.

Tyrion thought about it for a while, and felt that if he queued up according to the chest-to-back method, even all the men in the world combined would not be able to line up the distance from Slaver's Bay to Westeros.

It seems that this Dragon Queen is quite exaggerated.

While Margaery was still around, Arthur didn't bring up the idea of marrying Daenerys.

He raised another topic, "We are still at war, how can we discuss such a matter for so long?"

"Otherwise Dany, since we don't have many family members, you and I shouldn't fight over who sits on the Iron Throne, and there's no need for internal strife. Let's take down the Westerlands and Casterly Rock first. We can discuss it in detail later, and we can also let the Earl-level Nobles join the discussion, as long as the Iron Throne belongs to Targaryen."

Hearing this, the Dragon Queen raised her voice and asked, "What did you call me? As a nephew, can you call me by my first name?"

No relationship was confirmed, and Daenerys decided to overpower her nephew in terms of seniority.

The king smiled and joked: "I'll call you Dany, and you'll call me nephew. We'll each have our own ideas."

In fact, it's not impossible to call him aunt, just be a dragon knight for once!

But in such an occasion where there were many subordinate lords, the king still had to maintain the necessary dignity, so Arthur called them by their first names.

Seeing Arthur's shameless behavior, Dany looked at him with disdain and felt that she couldn't change it, so she just ignored it.

She turned her head and saw the dwarf among the nobles, and suddenly recognized the roaring lion emblem on Tyrion.

"Isn't this a Lannister? What are you doing? Tywin is so sinful, how come the Lions can still live in your camp?"

Dany was quite dissatisfied with this.

No matter who sits on the Iron Throne, the culprits Tywin and Lannister must be liquidated.

Killing women and children goes against the unspoken rules common among nobles, and this is no ordinary woman, she is the real wife of the crown prince and the princess of Dorne.

Speaking of which, Robert's sins when he sat on the Iron Throne were not as deep as Tywin's.

"The one who killed Princess Elia was the Mountain. I have already hammered it to pieces. I also beheaded Amory Lorch who participated in it. As for the rest of the crimes of the Lannister family, we have to wait until we capture Casterly Rock." Let’s settle the accounts together.”

Speaking of this, Arthur pointed at Tyrion, "In 283, this man was only ten years old and could not participate in the decision-making of the Lion family. If we add charges to him, it would be the same as the Mountain and Rocky who killed women and children. What's the difference?"

After seeing that Daenerys had turned to judging the Lannister crimes, the king took the opportunity to announce:

"Fighting the West is the most important thing for us. Kevan sent people before, saying that he wanted me to return Jaime the Kingslayer, and promised not to punish the West and the Lannister family before surrendering. But how can this happen? Is it possible? If the cost of rebellion is so small, then where is the dignity of the king and the royal family? "

The army is approaching the city, and Garland and the Riverbend army have secretly prepared for a sneak attack. Arthur will never let the Westlanders lose easily.

At least the Golden Tooth City must be removed from the Western Territory and placed under the jurisdiction of the Riverlands, while the gold mines in Castelmere City, Nunburg, and Pendry Hills must be handed over.

As for the silver mines in Silver Mountain City, Tarbeck Hall and other places, part of them must be handed over as punishment for the nobles of the West to rebel with the Lannister family.

The die-hard families of the Lion family such as Yangji Hall, Deep Cave Castle, and Brand City must also be weakened.

Demotion and title reduction are inevitable.

The reduced territories in the West can be divided among the families that support the royal family. Both the Usurper's War and the performance in this war must be taken into consideration.

This is also the key to why the people of Hebend and Hejian follow the king to raise troops. There is no benefit at all. Can these nobles bring out soldiers who are related to the fate of the family to fight?

He waved his hand and said, "Everyone, go back and reorganize the soldiers. Let them repair themselves first. In just two or three days, we will start a war with the people from the West."

"Enter Casterly Rock and capture Kevan alive."

The king shouted a slogan.

Many nobles responded one after another.

"Divide the West and destroy the Lannisters."

"Attack Casterly Rock."

"The minerals in the Western Region belong to us."

After shouting the slogans, the nobles left one after another. After Arthur comforted Margaery, he went to Daenerys' tent to discuss important matters.

After a long time.

"How is it possible? How can yours be so big?"

Dani exclaimed.
